exclusions: private activity dumps and screenshot receipts
raw adb-log directory and full device contents beyond selected environment metadata

verification_limitations: Public exports omit private evidence, binaries and the random smoke dump. Source/validator scripts are retained for review; original-data validators may require unpublished originals and original paths. verify_public.py verifies the sanitized exports. This package does not claim an independent public replay of MAA game-state interpretation or screenshot semantics.
